title: Staff tools
subtitle: For verified teachers and counselors: post local opportunities, recommend them to students, and see engagement.
codeHelp: Your school gives each staff member this code. Demo: RGV-STAFF
postHelp: Posts show in student searches with a ✓ Verified badge.
published: Published! Students will see it in search with a Verified badge.
alsoRecommend: Also recommend it to my students
scamBlocked: This post looks like it could be a scam (for example it asks for money upfront or personal info), so it wasn't published.
dashHelp: Only students who joined your school group AND chose to share their activity appear here. You see nicknames and counts — never their searches or chats.
dashEmpty: No students are sharing activity yet. Give students your school's student code (demo: RGV-STUDENT).
reportHelp: Anonymous counts of searches by type over the last {days} days. No student is identified.
clubSponsor: Sponsor (title only, e.g. Mr. R, Science)
modHelp: Posts reported by students are hidden automatically after 2 reports. Review them here.
